This

diagram
shows
the
taxi
service
work
flow
.
There
are
two
ways
that
customers
can
make
a
booking
.
The
first
way
is
to
make
a
booking
by
phone
,
so
that
an
operator
can
make
the
booking
directly
.
The
other
way
is
to
make
online
booking
.
The
booking
will
be
received
by
workstation
desktop
.
The
bookings
from
both
pathways
will
be
sent
to
taxi
service
server
so
that
taxi
drivers
will
be
sent
out
for
the
bookings
.
The
types
of
taxi
include
cars
,
vans
and
trucks
.
In
conclusion
,
this
flow
diagram
gives
detailed
information
about
taxi
booking
.
